column1: # AUTO-GENERATED by tools/datamine_esd_gates.py -- the EventFlag gating each merchant
# shop range, from ESDLang-decompiled ESD (thefifthmatt). gate_flag = the bell-bearing/
# release flag (-1 = ungated on that path); gate_sense = 1 set / 0 clear. Join
# shop_begin..end to ShopLineupParam rows for bell -> rows (MerchantBellLogic,
# multi-region resolution). A talk emits one row PER GATE PATH; rows are paths,
# not merchants. Args resolve through the ESD call chain (call-site kwargs),
# not just literals -- nomadic merchants forward shop1/shop2 ~5 hops.
# MEASURED THIS RUN: 137 sites (105 literal, 32 param) | 137 resolved | 183 rows,
#   118 distinct (talk,range) | 116 gated rows over 47 distinct gate flags
